resolution_notes: Verifier B's free_tier_limits and rate_limits (default ~1,000 QPD per project via Cloud Console quotas for books.googleapis.com) are supported by community/support threads and Console practice, but official Books docs still do not publish a fixed public quota table—so ship those as Console-backed defaults, not a separate RPM schedule. CORS: a live GET to the volumes endpoint returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, so cors=yes. Undisputed fields left null (keep original).
free_tier_limits: Default 1,000 queries per day per project (Google Cloud Console quotas for books.googleapis.com; increases via Console)
rate_limits: Default ~1,000 queries/day per project (Queries / defaultPerDayPerProject on books.googleapis.com); view/adjust in Cloud Console—no separate public RPM table
